title: Silverstein unveils the third leg of '25 Years of Noise' tour for the US: Dates, locations, and more explored - NewsBreak
text: On July 15, 2025, Silverstein shared a post on Instagram to officially announce the third and final leg of their 25 Years Of Noise global tour, which is also coming to several locations of the US. The North American leg of Silverstein’s tour is set to take off on November 18, 2025. In the final chapter to the band's 25th anniversary tour, the month-long journey will feature support from other popular bands, including MOVIELIFE, THURSDAY, Free Throw, and Bloom. They will be joining for the concluding performance in Brooklyn on December 20, 2025. Other locations like Minneapolis, Portland, Cincinnati, Milwaukee, and more will be covered in this US tour. In its recent IG post, the band stated that their tour celebrates their era. ​ The IG post of the band further highlighted that they will be performing a different setlist for North American tour. ​ Here’s the list of complete rundown of dates and locations of the upcoming final tour : The tickets sales will commence on July 18, 2025, at 10 AM local time. In August 2025, the group is set to perform in Australia. Besides, the group also announced dates for Latin American leg. This tour is happening in October this year.
